image_prompt.text: A large distinct rock formation or ruin visible from a distance so the player can orient themselves across the flat desert
Worn tracks and dry riverbeds threading the sand so movement across the waste has an obvious grain
Composed desert views framed from specific vantage points on the dunes
a vast arid wasteland desert of sand and cracked dry earth

notes: No game type was named, so no-genre defaults were used; every axis is default and the route is P0.
The desert terrain itself matches no option and is carried as free text in image_prompt.

open_questions.ask: Is there anything to do in the desert, or is this purely an environment to look at and walk around?
Should this be a walkable stretch of desert a few hundred studs across, or an open world you can drive across?

coverage_missing.ask: Is there anything to do in the desert, or is it a showcase environment?
How far should the player be able to walk before hitting the edge?
Does 'wasteland' mean post-apocalyptic ruins and rusted debris, or just natural empty desert?

answers.ask: Is there anything to do in the desert, or is this purely an environment to look at and walk around?
answers.answer: Make it a purely environmental 3D wasteland desert to look at and walk around; no gameplay mechanics are needed.

answers.ask: Should this be a walkable stretch of desert a few hundred studs across, or an open world you can drive across?
answers.answer: Use a walkable stretch of desert a few hundred studs across, keeping it small and explorable on foot.
